description: Tesla CEO and former White House adviser Elon Musk on Wednesday weighed in on legislation that would require ID and proof of citizenship to register to vote, warning that democracy could be at risk if the legislation isn’t enacted. “It must be done or democracy is dead,” Musk said on the social platform X, which…
title: Musk says SAVE Act requiring ID to vote ‘must be done or democracy is dead’
